description: Triage: every finding is a suggested fix at Important or Minor naming one concrete change (a total computed too early, a test gap, a leaked file handle), off the security axis and about nothing the user specified. All three go to the implementer with the Plan line; nothing remains for the user, so the reply makes no ask at all, the Log (not Decisions) records an automatic fix, one status line names R1 to R3, and the stage is fix.
prompt:
<cross-session-message from="uds:/tmp/cc-socks/5120.sock" from-name="reviewer" from-mode="prompting">
Reviewer pass: full @ 3f9c2a1
PR: https://github.com/o/app/pull/12
Tests: pass — 41/41 — `pytest -q`
Axes not examined: none
R1 | Correctness | Important | Confirmed | src/a/upload.py:20 | the byte total is computed before the loop adds the last chunk | move the sum after the loop | suggested: fix
R2 | Test run | Important | Confirmed | tests/test_upload.py:1 | no case for an empty file | add one test case for an empty file | suggested: fix
R3 | Correctness | Minor | Confirmed | src/a/upload.py:9 | the error path returns before closing the file handle | add the close in a finally block | suggested: fix
Assessment: three findings.
</cross-session-message>

graders.name: reads the review-pipeline skill before the first fix send
graders.rule: Send each automatic fix at once, without asking, to the owning session with `Plan: enter plan mode (EnterPlanMode) for this task before anything else; write nothing until the user approves the plan.`, as every assignment is, and leave it out of the ask.

graders.name: R1 is sent for a fix (all-clear) (one send per fix is fine)
R2 is sent for a fix (all-clear) (one send per fix is fine)
R3 is sent for a fix (all-clear) (one send per fix is fine)
the send carries the Plan line
graders.text_match: Plan: enter plan mode \(EnterPlanMode\) for this task before anything else; write nothing until the user approves the plan\.

graders.name: the send waives no plan approval
the reply asks nothing: no question mark
the reply asks nothing: no ask words
